cohort: 571 neonates admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit at Black Lion Specialized Hospital, Ethiopia, between January 2013 and March 2018
finding: Preterm birth, caesarean section delivery, low Apgar score, home delivery, maternal diabetes, and sepsis were identified as significant predictors of respiratory distress in neonates.
mod_finding: Neonates born via caesarean section had a significantly higher risk of developing respiratory distress compared to those born vaginally.
